components.author: DavidR
components.name: Scale 1D
components.info: Create a dilation, or scaling transformation, in a single direction. If an input shape is provided, it will be scaled accordingly.

inputs.name: Factor
inputs.info: Scaling factor along the axis, pinned at the axis start point.

components.summary: 沿单一方向做缩放变换。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Scale 2D
components.info: Create two-dimensional dilation, or scaling transformation. If an input shape is provided, it will be scaled accordingly.

inputs.name: Factor
inputs.info: Uniform scaling factor in the origin plane X and Y directions.

components.summary: 在平面内做二维缩放变换。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Scale 3D
components.info: Create a dilation, or scaling transformation, which is equal in all directions. If an input shape is provided, it will be scaled accordingly.

inputs.name: Factor
inputs.info: Uniform scaling factor towards or away from the origin.

components.summary: 各方向等比例缩放。

detail.concept: 三轴缩放：分别沿 X、Y、Z 方向按比例放大或缩小几何，可绕指定平面进行。
steps: 设置三个方向的缩放因子。
可选接缩放中心平面，输出缩放后的几何。

scenes.title: 体量等比推敲
scenes.body: 整体 1.2 倍放大看比例是否还成立，比重新建模快得多。

scenes.title: 竖向拉高
scenes.body: 只放大 Z 方向，快速做层高对比方案。

pitfalls: 缩放中心默认在世界原点，几何会同时被「推走」，需要定位时接平面。
非等比缩放会让圆变成椭圆、法线方向改变。
detail.tip: 缩放永远问一句：以哪里为中心？不问就会飞走。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Scale Non-uniform
components.info: Create a dilation, or scaling transformation, using different factors in the X, Y, and Z directions. If an input shape is provided, it will be scaled accordingly.

inputs.name: Plane
inputs.info: Plane specifying the origin and axis directions of the scaling transformation.

inputs.name: Factor X
inputs.info: Scaling factor in plane X direction.

inputs.name: Factor Y
inputs.info: Scaling factor in plane Y direction.

inputs.name: Factor Z
inputs.info: Scaling factor in plane Z direction.

components.summary: X、Y、Z 方向用不同系数缩放。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Scale To Area
components.info: Resize a shape equally in all directions until its area falls within an allowed range. This component assumes the area of a shape changes with the square of the scaling factor.
components.summary: 等比缩放形状，直到面积落入允许范围。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Scale To Volume
components.info: Resize a shape equally in all directions until its volume falls within an allowed range. This component assumes the volume of a shape changes with the cube of the scaling factor.
components.summary: 等比缩放形状，直到体积落入允许范围。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Camera Obscura
components.info: Invert a shape through the pinhole point of a camera obscura. If an input shape is provided, it will be transformed accordingly.

inputs.name: Factor
inputs.info: Scaling factor for the inverted projection.

components.summary: 把形状通过小孔点做反演。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Mirror
components.info: Create a reflection transformation in a plane. If an input shape is provided, it will be transformed accordingly.
components.summary: 按平面生成镜像变换。

detail.concept: 镜像：以指定平面为镜面，把几何翻到另一侧。

scenes.title: 对称立面
scenes.body: 做一半立面后镜像到另一侧，保证左右完全对称。
scenes.wiring: 半侧构件 + 中轴平面 → Mirror

pitfalls: 镜像平面法线方向决定结果在哪一侧，法线反了会翻到同一侧重叠。
镜像会翻转几何方向（法线朝内），后续布尔运算前先检查。
detail.tip: 对称造型只建一半，镜像不仅快，还能保证严格对称。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Project
components.info: Create a projection transformation onto a plane.If an input shape is provided, it will be transformed accordingly.
components.summary: 生成投影到某个平面的变换。

detail.concept: 把几何投影到目标上（平面或曲面），可按指定方向投影或取最近点。
steps: 可给投影方向，输出投影后的几何。

scenes.title: 总图落位
scenes.body: 把三维体量按竖直方向投影到地面，得到平面轮廓用于总图。
scenes.wiring: 体量 + 地面 → Project(Z 向)

pitfalls: 不给方向时按最近点投影，结果会贴到最近的面上，可能不是你想要的那一层。
投影到曲面会让曲线变形甚至自交。
detail.tip: 出平面图优先显式给方向，避免「投到背面」这种意外。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Project Along
components.info: Create a projection transformation onto a plane along a given direction. If an input shape is provided, it will be transformed accordingly.

inputs.name: Direction
inputs.info: Projection direction. Must not be parallel to the plane.

components.summary: 沿指定方向投影到平面，生成变换。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Box Mapping
components.info: Transform a shape using source and target reference boxes. The specifics of the transformation are encoded by the differences between the boxes. If an input shape is provided, it will be transformed accordingly.

outputs.name: Transformation
outputs.info: Transformation consisting of the translation, dilation and rotation required to go from the source to the target box.

components.summary: 用源盒与目标盒的差异把形状映射过去。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Change Of Basis
components.info: Create a transformation from one oblique coordinate system into another.

inputs.name: Source Origin
inputs.info: Point of origin of the source coordinate system.

inputs.name: Source X
inputs.info: X unit vector of the source coordinate system.

inputs.name: Source Y
inputs.info: Y unit vector of the source coordinate system.

inputs.name: Source Z
inputs.info: Z unit vector of the source coordinate system.

inputs.name: Target Origin
inputs.info: Point of origin of the target coordinate system.

inputs.name: Target X
inputs.info: X unit vector of the target coordinate system.

inputs.name: Target Y
inputs.info: Y unit vector of the target coordinate system.

inputs.name: Target Z
inputs.info: Z unit vector of the target coordinate system.

components.summary: 在两组斜坐标系之间生成变换。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Rectangle Mapping
components.info: Transform a shape using source and target reference rectangles. The specifics of the transformation are encoded by the differences between the rectangles.

outputs.name: Transformation
outputs.info: Transformation consisting of the translation, dilation and rotation required to go from the source to the target rectangle.

components.summary: 用源矩形与目标矩形的差异把形状映射过去。

components.author: DanP
components.name: Tetrahedron Mapping
components.info: Transform a shape using source and target reference tetrahedra. The specifics of the transformation are encoded by the differences between the tetrahedra.

inputs.name: Source
inputs.info: The four vertices of the tetrahedron representing the initial state.

inputs.name: Target
inputs.info: The four vertices of the tetrahedron representing the final state.

outputs.name: Transformation
outputs.info: Transformation consisting of the translation, dilation, rotation and shearing required to go from the source to the target tetrahedron.

components.summary: 用源四面体与目标四面体的差异映射形状。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Triangle Mapping
components.info: Transform a shape using source and target reference triangles. The specifics of the transformation are encoded by the differences between the triangles.

outputs.name: Transformation
outputs.info: Transformation consisting of the translation, dilation, rotation and shearing required to go from the source to the target triangle.

components.summary: 用源三角形与目标三角形的差异映射形状。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Classify Transform
components.info: Classify a transformation based on its mathematical category.

outputs.name: Identity
outputs.info: True if the transformation equals the identity matrix and does not affect shapes at all.

outputs.name: Translation
outputs.info: True if the transformation contains only translations.

outputs.name: Rotation
outputs.info: True if the transformation contains only rotations.

outputs.name: Rigid
outputs.info: True if the transformation is made up of a combination of translations and rotations.

outputs.name: Similarity
outputs.info: True if the transformation is made up of a combination of translations, rotations, dilations and reflections.

outputs.name: Affine
outputs.info: True if the transformation is affine, meaning it lacks perspective or tapering aspects.

components.summary: 按数学类别判断一个变换属于哪一类。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Dilation Vector
components.info: Extract the dilation vector of a transformation matrix, corrected for rotation.

outputs.name: X Factor
outputs.info: Scaling factor for the X direction.

outputs.name: Y Factor
outputs.info: Scaling factor for the Y direction.

outputs.name: Z Factor
outputs.info: Scaling factor for the Z direction.

components.summary: 取出变换矩阵中的缩放向量（已修正旋转影响）。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Translation Vector
components.info: Extract the translation vector of a transformation matrix. Note that rotation and dilation will manifest as a kind of translation too, but are not included in these outputs.

outputs.name: X Motion
outputs.info: Translation motion in the X direction.

outputs.name: Y Motion
outputs.info: Translation motion in the Y direction.

outputs.name: Z Motion
outputs.info: Translation motion in the Z direction.

components.summary: 取出变换矩阵的平移向量（不含旋转与缩放造成的位移）。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Extract Dilation
components.info: Extract the dilational aspect of a transformation.

outputs.name: Pivot
outputs.info: Origin point of the embedded dilation.

outputs.name: Factor
outputs.info: Scaling factor of the embedded dilation.

components.summary: 取出变换中的缩放部分。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Extract Rotation
components.info: Extract the axis and the angle of a rotational transformation.
components.summary: 取出旋转变换的轴与角度。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Extract Translation
components.info: Extract the translational aspect of a transformation.

outputs.name: Translation
outputs.info: Translation embedded in the given transformation.

components.summary: 取出变换中的平移部分。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Extract Yaw-Pitch-Roll
components.info: Extract the yaw, pitch and roll angles of a transformation.

outputs.name: Yaw
outputs.info: Yaw rotation embedded in the transformation.

outputs.name: Pitch
outputs.info: Pitch rotation embedded in the transformation.

outputs.name: Roll
outputs.info: Roll rotation embedded in the transformation.

components.summary: 取出变换的偏航、俯仰与滚转角。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Decompose Affine
components.info: Decompose an affine transformation into a linear and a translational aspect.

outputs.name: Translation
outputs.info: Translational aspect of the given transformation.

outputs.name: Linear
outputs.info: Linear aspect of the given transformation.

components.summary: 把仿射变换拆成线性部分与平移部分。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Decompose Rigid
components.info: Decompose a rigid transformation into a translational and a rotational aspect.

outputs.name: Translation
outputs.info: Translational aspect of the given transformation.

outputs.name: Rotation
outputs.info: Rotational aspect of the given transformation.

components.summary: 把刚体变换拆成平移与旋转两部分。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Decompose Similarity
components.info: Decompose a similarity transformation into a translation, a dilation and a rotational aspect.

outputs.name: Translation
outputs.info: Translational aspect of the given transformation.

outputs.name: Dilation
outputs.info: Dilational aspect of the given transformation.

outputs.name: Rotation
outputs.info: Rotational aspect of the given transformation.

components.summary: 把相似变换拆成平移、缩放与旋转。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Shear From Angles
components.info: Create a shearing transformation based on X and Y angles. If an input shape is provided, it will be sheared accordingly.

inputs.name: Plane
inputs.info: Shearing base plane. Geometry within this plane does not get transformed.

inputs.name: X Angle
inputs.info: Shearing angle around the plane X-axis.

inputs.name: Y Angle
inputs.info: Shearing angle around the plane Y-axis.

inputs.name: Maintain Height
inputs.info: If true, the shearing magnitude is adjusted to maintain elevations.

components.summary: 按 X、Y 两个方向角生成错切变换。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Shear From Normal
components.info: Creating a shearing transformation towards a custom direction. If an input shape is provided, it will be sheared accordingly.

inputs.name: Plane
inputs.info: Shearing base plane. Geometry within this plane does not get transformed.

components.summary: 朝自定义方向生成错切变换。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Apply Deform
components.info: Apply a non-linear spatial deformation to a shape.

inputs.name: Preserve
inputs.info: If true, the underlying control-point structure is preserved during deformation.

components.summary: 对形状施加非线性空间形变。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Combine Deform
components.info: Combine two non-linear spatial deformations.
components.summary: 把两个非线性形变组合成一个。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Bend Deform
components.info: Create a bending deformation. If an input shape is provided, it will be deformed accordingly.

inputs.name: Bending Arc
inputs.info: Arc defining the start, length, and angles of the bending portion of the deformation.

components.summary: 生成弯曲形变。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Curl Deform
components.info: Create a curling deformation. Curling is similar to wringing, but with a curved axis. If an input shape is provided, it will be deformed accordingly.

inputs.name: Angle
inputs.info: Either a global angle, or a function which defines a unique angle for every parameter along the axis curve.

inputs.name: Degrees
inputs.info: If true, function values are interpreted to represent angular degrees. If false, it is assumed to be in radians.

components.summary: 生成沿弯曲轴的卷曲形变。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Expand Deform
components.info: Create an expansion deformation. If an input shape is provided, it will be deformed accordingly.

inputs.name: Seed
inputs.info: Seed from which expansion is measured. May be a point, a plane, an infinite line, or a curve.

inputs.name: Factor
inputs.info: Function encoding the scaling factor based on the distance to the seed. Ideally this function is strictly increasing.

components.summary: 生成膨胀型形变。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Field Deform
components.info: Create a vector field deformation. If an input shape is provided, it will be deformed accordingly.

inputs.name: Motion
inputs.info: Optional magnitude of particle motion through the field.

components.summary: 用向量场生成形变。

components.author: DanPiker
components.name: Maelstrom Deform
components.info: Create a spiral deformation. If an input shape is provided, it will be deformed accordingly.
components.summary: 生成螺旋形变。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Offset Deform
components.info: Create an offset deformation. If an input shape is provided, it will be deformed accordingly.

inputs.name: Seed
inputs.info: Seed from which the offset is measured. May be a point, a plane, an infinite line, or a curve.

inputs.name: Factor
inputs.info: Function encoding the offset amount based on the distance to the seed. Ideally the function intersects $(0,0)$.

components.summary: 生成偏移型形变。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Splop Deform
components.info: Create a splop deformation which maps from flat space into surface UVW space. If an input shape is provided, it will be deformed accordingly.

inputs.name: Locus
inputs.info: Surface locus where the deformation origin is anchored.

components.summary: 把平面空间中的物体映射到曲面 UVW 空间。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Sporph Deform
components.info: Create a sporph deformation which maps between surface UVW spaces. If an input shape is provided, it will be deformed accordingly.

inputs.name: Source
inputs.info: Reference source surface for sporph deformation.

components.summary: 在两张曲面的 UVW 空间之间映射。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Stretch Deform
components.info: Create a stretching deformation. If an input shape is provided, it will be deformed accordingly.

inputs.name: Line
inputs.info: Line covering the region to be stretched.

inputs.name: Length
inputs.info: Length of stretched line, as measured from the fixed start.

components.summary: 生成拉伸型形变。

components.author: DanPiker
components.name: Taper Deform
components.info: Create a tapering deformation. If an input shape is provided, it will be deformed accordingly.

inputs.name: Start Radius
inputs.info: Radius at the start of the taper axis.

inputs.name: End Radius
inputs.info: Radius at the end of the taper axis.

inputs.name: Infinite
inputs.info: If true, the taper deformation extends infinitely beyond the limits of the axis.

components.summary: 生成锥化（截面渐变）形变。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Twist Deform
components.info: Create a twisting deformation. If an input shape is provided, it will be deformed accordingly.

inputs.name: Angle 1
inputs.info: Rotational angle at the start of the axis.

inputs.name: Angle 2
inputs.info: Rotational angle at the end of the axis.

inputs.name: Profile
inputs.info: Progression of the twist along the axis.

components.summary: 生成等角速度的扭转形变。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Twist Deform
components.info: Create a twisting deformation. If an input shape is provided, it will be deformed accordingly.

inputs.name: Angle 1
inputs.info: Rotational angle at the start of the axis.

inputs.name: Angle 2
inputs.info: Rotational angle at the end of the axis.

components.summary: 旧版扭转形变，保留用于兼容。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Wring Deform
components.info: Create a wringing deformation. Wringing is similar to twisting, but with a variable angle progression. If an input shape is provided, it will be deformed accordingly.

inputs.name: Plane
inputs.info: Orientation plane. The wringing axis is coincident with the plane z-axis.

inputs.name: Angle
inputs.info: Function describing the wringing angle based on distance to plane.

inputs.name: Degrees
inputs.info: If true, the function values represent angles measured in degrees instead of radians.

components.summary: 生成角度渐变的拧扭形变。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Flow Along Curve
components.info: Create a deformation from one axial curve to another. If an input shape is provided, it will be deformed accordingly.

inputs.name: Source
inputs.info: Optional source curve. If omitted, a line tangent with the start of the target curve is used.

inputs.name: R Factor
inputs.info: Scaling factor radial to the target curve.

components.summary: 把物体从一条轴曲线「流」到另一条曲线。

detail.concept: 沿曲线流动：把几何从一条参考曲线「流」到目标曲线上，自动跟随曲率变形。
steps: Geometry 端接要流动的几何。
Target 端接目标曲线，输出变形后的几何。

scenes.title: 栏杆贴合弧形路径
scenes.body: 在直线上排好栏杆花纹，再整体流到弧形路径上，省掉逐个定位。
scenes.wiring: 直排花纹 + 直线 + 弧线 → Flow

pitfalls: 目标曲线比参考曲线短时几何会被压缩甚至重叠。
参考曲线必须真的穿过几何，否则流动结果会整体偏移。
detail.tip: 流动前把参考曲线与几何「摆在一起」，是最省心的做法。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Flow Along Surface
components.info: Create a flow deformation which maps onto a surface UVW space. If an input shape is provided, it will be deformed accordingly.

inputs.name: Source
inputs.info: Source space in the form of a rectilinear box.

inputs.name: U Domain
inputs.info: Optional U domain for target space. If omitted, the entire domain will be used.

inputs.name: V Domain
inputs.info: Optional V domain for target space. If omitted, the entire domain will be used.

inputs.name: W Factor
inputs.info: Scaling factor in the surface normal direction.

components.summary: 把物体映射到曲面的 UVW 空间。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Mirror In Curve
components.info: Create a curve mirror deformation. If an input shape is provided, it will be deformed accordingly.

inputs.name: Shape
inputs.info: Optional shape to mirror in the curve.

inputs.name: Infinite
inputs.info: If true, open mirror curves are extended linearly at both ends.

components.summary: 按曲线生成镜像形变。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Mirror In Surface
components.info: Create a surface mirror deformation. If an input shape is provided, it will be deformed accordingly.

inputs.name: Shape
inputs.info: Optional shape to mirror in the surface.

inputs.name: Infinite
inputs.info: If true, the reflection occurs in the tangent plane at the closest point on the surface.

components.summary: 按曲面生成镜像形变。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Cage Between Edges

inputs.name: Front Right Edge
inputs.info: Edge in cage W direction at $(u,v)$ = (1,0)

inputs.name: Back Left Edge
inputs.info: Edge in cage W direction at $(u,v)$ = (0,1)

inputs.name: Back Right Edge
inputs.info: Edge in cage W direction at $(u,v)$ = (1,1)

inputs.name: Degree U
inputs.info: Degree in cage U direction, between 1 and 7.

inputs.name: Degree V
inputs.info: Degree in cage V direction, between 1 and 7.

inputs.name: Degree W
inputs.info: Degree in cage W direction, between 1 and 7.

components.summary: 在四条边之间生成扭曲笼。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Cage Between Faces
components.info: Create a twisted box cage between two surfaces.

inputs.name: Bottom
inputs.info: Surface for bottom face of cage.

inputs.name: Top
inputs.info: Surface for top face of cage.

inputs.name: Degree U
inputs.info: Degree in cage U direction, between 1 and 7.

inputs.name: Degree V
inputs.info: Degree in cage V direction, between 1 and 7.

inputs.name: Degree W
inputs.info: Degree in cage W direction, between 1 and 7.

components.summary: 在两张曲面之间生成扭曲笼。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Cage Deform
components.info: Create a cage deformation. If an input shape is provided, it will be deformed accordingly.

inputs.name: Source
inputs.info: Simple box representing the initial form.

inputs.name: Target
inputs.info: Twisted cage representing the final form.

components.summary: 生成基于控制笼的形变。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Cage From Corners
components.info: Create a twisted box cage with straight edges out of eight corner points.

outputs.name: Cage
outputs.info: Twisted box cage with straight edges.

components.summary: 用八个角点生成边为直线的扭曲笼。

components.author: DanP
components.name: Cage From Surface
components.info: Create a deformation cage on a single-face surface.

inputs.name: U Interval
inputs.info: U interval for the subsurface to create the cage on.

inputs.name: V Interval
inputs.info: V interval for the subsurface to create the cage on.

inputs.name: Degree U
inputs.info: Degree in cage U direction, between 1 and 7.

inputs.name: Degree V
inputs.info: Degree in cage V direction, between 1 and 7.

inputs.name: Degree W
inputs.info: Degree in cage W direction, between 1 and 7.

components.summary: 在单张曲面上生成形变笼。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Evaluate Cage
components.info: Evaluate a cage at normalised (u,v,w) parameters.

inputs.name: U Parameter
inputs.info: Normalised parameter in the cage U direction.

inputs.name: V Parameter
inputs.info: Normalised parameter in the cage V direction.

inputs.name: W Parameter
inputs.info: Normalised parameter in the cage W direction.

components.summary: 在归一化 (u, v, w) 参数处求笼内的位置。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Quaternion From Coefficients
components.info: Create a quaternion out of A, B, C, and D coefficients.
components.summary: 用 A、B、C、D 系数构造四元数。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Quaternion From Orientation
components.info: Create the quaternion needed to rotate from a source to a target plane.

outputs.name: Quaternion
outputs.info: Quaternion encoding the rotation from A to B.

components.summary: 求出把源平面转到目标平面所需的四元数。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Quaternion From Rotation
components.info: Convert an axial rotation into an equivalent quaternion.
components.summary: 把轴向旋转转换成等价的四元数。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Quaternion Standard
components.info: Create a quaternion standard value.
components.summary: 生成一组标准四元数常量。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Invert Quaternion
components.info: Invert a quaternion by dividing all vector coefficients by the negative of the length squared.
components.summary: 按定义求出四元数的逆。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Unitise Quaternion
components.info: Unitise a quaternion so that $A²+B²+C²+D²$ equals $1$.
components.summary: 把四元数归一化，使系数平方和为 1。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Quaternion Lerp
components.info: Interpolate between two quaternions using linear interpolation.
components.summary: 在两个四元数之间做线性插值。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Quaternion Slerp
components.info: Interpolate between two quaternions using spherical-linear interpolation.
components.summary: 在两个四元数之间做球面线性插值。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Rotate Towards
components.info: Rotate one quaternion towards another.
components.summary: 把一个四元数朝另一个方向旋转。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Classify Quaternion
components.info: Classify a quaternion by its properties.

outputs.name: Valid
outputs.info: If true, the quaternion is valid.

outputs.name: Zero
outputs.info: If true, all coefficients equal zero.

outputs.name: Scalar
outputs.info: If true, the scalar coefficient is non-zero, while all vector coefficients equal zero.

outputs.name: Vector
outputs.info: If true, at least one of the vector coefficients is not zero.

outputs.name: Unit
outputs.info: If true, the quaternion has unit length.

components.summary: 按性质判断四元数的类型。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Dissect Quaternion
components.info: Dissect a quaternion by extracting the A, B, C, and D coefficients.
components.summary: 把四元数拆成 A、B、C、D 四个系数。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Quaternion Distance
components.info: Compute the norm-distance between two quaternions.

outputs.name: Distance
outputs.info: Norm-distance between the two given quaternions.

components.summary: 计算两个四元数之间的范数距离。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Rotation From Quaternion
components.info: Convert a quaternion into an equivalent axial rotation.

outputs.name: Axis
outputs.info: Rotation axis, anchored at the world origin.

components.summary: 把四元数转换成等价的轴向旋转。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Move
components.info: Create a translation transformation along a vector. If an input shape is provided, it will be transformed accordingly.
components.summary: 沿向量生成平移变换；接形状时直接移动形状。

detail.concept: 沿向量平移。它既是「变换」也可以直接作用于几何：接形状就输出移动后的形状，不接就输出一个变换对象，留给下游统一使用。
steps: 给移动向量：可以直接给向量，也可以给起点到终点的方向。
需要沿多个方向复用时，把输出的变换接给「组合变换」。

scenes.title: 层间复制
scenes.body: 把标准层沿 Z 方向按层高移动，配合重复变换得到整栋楼。
scenes.wiring: 楼板 → Move(0,0,层高) → 重复

scenes.title: 沿法向偏移
scenes.body: 把点沿曲面法向移动，生成偏移后的定位点。

pitfalls: 移动向量如果来自点而不是向量，会变成「从原点指向该点」的位移。
对树做移动时，每枝分别移动，向量数量不足会循环使用。
detail.tip: 移动是最容易验证的变换：先移一个，确认方向对了再批量。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Move Onto Plane
components.info: Move a shape in a direction perpendicular to a plane, until the plane and shape come into contact.

inputs.name: Above
inputs.info: If true, move objects above the plane.

inputs.name: Below
inputs.info: If true, move objects below the plane.

components.summary: 沿垂直方向移动形状，直到与平面接触。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Move Polar
components.info: Create a translation transformation using polar coordinates. If an input shape is provided, it will be transformed accordingly.
components.summary: 用极坐标分量生成平移变换。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Move With Field
components.info: Move a shape using the flow of a vector field, as measured at the centre of the shape bounding box.

inputs.name: Field
inputs.info: Field exerting a force on the shape.

inputs.name: Strength
inputs.info: Motion strength. Single Step scales the field vector by it, Integrate reads it as the duration of the flow, and Trajectory reads it as the length of the trajectory. Negative values move the shape upstream.

components.summary: 按形状中心处的场方向移动形状。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Move With Field
components.info: Move a shape using the direction and magnitude of a vector field, as measured at the centre of the shape bounding box.

inputs.name: Field
inputs.info: Field exerting a force on the shape.

components.summary: 旧版随场移动组件，保留用于兼容。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Orient
components.info: Create an orientation transformation from one plane to another. An orientation consists of translational and rotational aspects. If an input shape is provided, it will be transformed accordingly.
components.summary: 把一个平面上的物体搬到另一个平面，位置与朝向同时变。

detail.concept: 朝向对齐：把一个平面上的物体搬到另一个平面，位置和朝向同时变。它是「让构件跟着曲面/曲线走」的关键组件，比单纯移动多了一个旋转。
steps: 给源平面（几何当前所处的坐标系，通常是世界 XY 平面）。
给目标平面（几何要去的位置与朝向）。
输出就是搬到目标平面的几何。

scenes.title: 沿曲面布构件
scenes.body: 用曲面上的局部平面做目标平面，让每块面板贴合曲面倾斜。
scenes.wiring: 面板 + 世界XY + 曲面坐标系 → Orient

scenes.title: 沿曲线排布
scenes.body: 用曲线坐标系做目标，让构件跟随曲线转弯。
scenes.wiring: 构件 + 世界XY + 曲线坐标系 → Orient

pitfalls: 源平面选错（比如本该用世界 XY 却用了别的），构件会带一个额外旋转。
目标平面数量多于几何时，几何会被复制多次——这常被误认为 bug。
detail.tip: 想让构件「长在面上」，就用朝向对齐而不是移动。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Orient 2D
components.info: Create an orientation transformation from one axis to another. A two-dimensional orientation consists of translational, rotational, and dilational aspects. If an input shape is provided, it will be transformed accordingly.
components.summary: 按轴对齐生成二维朝向变换，含缩放。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Orient Direction
components.info: Create an orientation transformation from one direction to another in 3D space.
components.summary: 把三维空间中的一个方向转到另一个方向。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Rotate About Axis
components.info: Create a rotation around an origin point and an axis direction. If an input shape is provided, it will be rotated accordingly.

inputs.name: Angle
inputs.info: Rotational angle. Positive angles cause a counter-clockwise rotation.

components.summary: 绕指定原点与轴方向生成旋转。

detail.concept: 绕指定原点与轴方向旋转。角度单位要与 GH2 内部约定一致（角度类型或弧度），混用是最常见的错误来源。
steps: 给角度；需要摆到特定朝向时配合朝向对齐更省心。

scenes.title: 扭转塔楼
scenes.body: 每层绕中心轴旋转固定角度，逐层累加得到扭转形态。
scenes.wiring: 楼板 → Rotate(每层角度) → 重复

pitfalls: 角度单位错用会让旋转量差 57 倍。
轴向量为零时旋转会失效且不报错。
detail.tip: 不确定单位时，先转 90° 看结果，一次就能试出来。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Rotate Direction
components.info: Create a rotation from one direction to another. If an input shape is provided, it will be rotated accordingly.
components.summary: 生成把一个方向转到另一个方向的旋转。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Rotate In Plane
components.info: Create a rotation around the origin and the normal axis of a plane. If an input shape is provided, it will be rotated accordingly.

inputs.name: Angle
inputs.info: Rotational angle. Positive angles cause a counter-clockwise rotation.

components.summary: 绕平面的原点与法向在平面内旋转。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Rotate Euler Angles
components.info: Create a rotation through Euler angles.

inputs.name: Alpha
inputs.info: First rotation about the world Z axis.

inputs.name: Beta
inputs.info: Second rotation about the world Y axis.

inputs.name: Gamma
inputs.info: Third rotation about the world Z axis again.

components.summary: 用欧拉角生成旋转。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Yaw Pitch Roll
components.info: Create a rotation through Tait-Bryan angles, commonly known as Yaw, Pitch, and Roll.

inputs.name: Yaw
inputs.info: Yaw rotation about the world Z axis.

inputs.name: Pitch
inputs.info: Pitch rotation about the world Y axis.

inputs.name: Roll
inputs.info: Roll rotation about the world X axis.

components.summary: 用 Tait-Bryan 角（偏航/俯仰/滚转）生成旋转。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Array Boxular
components.info: Create a volumetric, orthogonal array of translations. If an input shape is provided, it will be transformed accordingly.

inputs.name: Cell
inputs.info: Grid cell describing the spacing between adjacent array elements.

inputs.name: Range X
inputs.info: Number of array elements in the cell X direction.

inputs.name: Range Y
inputs.info: Number of array elements in the cell Y direction.

inputs.name: Range Z
inputs.info: Number of array elements in the cell Z direction.

outputs.name: Transformations
outputs.info: List of translations applied to each element in the array.

components.summary: 生成三维正交排布的体阵列。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Array Linear
components.info: Create a linear array of translations. If an input shape is provided, it will be transformed accordingly.

inputs.name: Motion
inputs.info: Motion vector describing the spacing between adjacent array elements.

outputs.name: Transformations
outputs.info: List of translations applied to each element in the array.

components.summary: 生成一串平移的线性阵列。

detail.concept: 一维阵列：沿一个方向按数量与间距复制几何。

scenes.title: 栏杆立杆
scenes.body: 沿扶手方向按 1.1 米间距排布立杆。

pitfalls: 数量包含原始件，写 20 得到的是一共 20 个。
方向向量长度会影响间距，通常先归一化再乘间距。
detail.tip: 沿曲线排布用 Array Along Curve，直线排布才用 Array 1D。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Array Rectangular
components.info: Create a rectangular array of translations. If an input shape is provided, it will be transformed accordingly.

inputs.name: Cell
inputs.info: Grid cell describing the spacing between adjacent array elements.

inputs.name: Range X
inputs.info: Number of array elements in the cell X direction.

inputs.name: Range Y
inputs.info: Number of array elements in the cell Y direction.

outputs.name: Transformations
outputs.info: List of translations applied to each element in the array.

components.summary: 生成矩形平面上的阵列。

detail.concept: 二维阵列：把几何按行列复制成网格，行列间距可分别设置。
steps: 设置 X、Y 方向的数量与间距。
输出阵列后的几何列表。

scenes.title: 标准柱网
scenes.body: 一根柱按 8 米、9 米柱距阵列成整层柱网。
scenes.wiring: 柱 → Array 2D(间距) → 整层柱

pitfalls: 数量包含原始那一个，写 10 会得到 10 个而不是 11 个。
间距是相对值，几何本身已有位置偏移时会叠加。
detail.tip: 阵列数量与间距是两件事，改数量前先确认间距对不对。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Array Along Curve
components.info: Create an array of transformations along a rail curve. If an input shape is provided, it will be transformed accordingly.

inputs.name: Count
inputs.info: Number of transformed elements along the curve.

inputs.name: Orientation
inputs.info: Orientation constraint for the arrayed shapes.

outputs.name: Transformations
outputs.info: List of transformations applied to each element in the array.

components.summary: 沿轨道曲线生成一串变换阵列。

detail.concept: 沿一条曲线生成一串变换阵列：位置沿曲线分布，朝向跟随曲线切向。它是「沿路径排布」的标准做法。
steps: 给数量或间距，必要时指定对齐方式。

scenes.title: 栏杆立杆
scenes.body: 沿扶手曲线等距排布立杆，并让其跟随曲线倾斜。
scenes.wiring: 立杆 + 扶手曲线 → Array Along Curve

pitfalls: 曲线方向反了阵列会从另一端开始，用翻转曲线修正。
数量过多时预览会明显变卡，先减量验证。
detail.tip: 阵列自带朝向，比「等分 + 逐个移动」更省步骤。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Array Arcular
components.info: Create an arc shaped array of rotations spanning a sweep angle. If an input shape is provided, it will be transformed accordingly.

inputs.name: Plane
inputs.info: Centre and orientation of the array.

inputs.name: Angle
inputs.info: Sweep angle of the array, measured counter-clockwise from the plane x-axis.

inputs.name: Count
inputs.info: Number of elements in the array.

inputs.name: Extent
inputs.info: Rule for how the sweep is filled with elements.

outputs.name: Transformations
outputs.info: List of rotations applied to each element in the array.

components.summary: 在指定扫掠角内生成弧形旋转阵列。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Array Circular
components.info: Create a circular array of rotations. If an input shape is provided, it will be transformed accordingly.

inputs.name: Plane
inputs.info: Centre and orientation of circular array.

inputs.name: Count
inputs.info: Number of elements in the array.

outputs.name: Transformations
outputs.info: List of rotations applied to each element in the array.

components.summary: 生成整圈的旋转阵列。

detail.concept: 环形阵列：把几何绕一根轴按角度复制成一圈，常用于柱列、灯具、栏杆。
steps: 设置数量与总角度，输出阵列结果。

scenes.title: 圆形中庭柱列
scenes.body: 一根柱子绕中庭中心轴阵列 12 份，得到完整柱圈。

pitfalls: 总角度 360 度时首尾会重叠一份，数量要按 n 还是 n+1 想清楚。
阵列以轴为中心，几何本身离轴的距离决定了环的半径。
detail.tip: 环形阵列前先把「离轴距离」调好，半径就自然对了。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Array From Gaps
components.info: Create a sequence of shapes along a curve with a specific gap size. If an input shape is provided, it will be transformed accordingly.
components.summary: 沿曲线按固定间隙排布一串形状。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Array Polar
components.info: Create a polar array of rotations. If an input shape is provided, it will be transformed accordingly.

inputs.name: Plane
inputs.info: Centre and orientation of polar array.

inputs.name: Elevation
inputs.info: Optional function giving the elevation of each array element. The function must be scaled to element index, rather than element angle.

outputs.name: Transformations
outputs.info: List of transformations applied to each element in the array.

components.summary: 用极坐标生成旋转阵列。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Transform Shape
components.info: Transform a shape and its meta data with a given transformation.
components.summary: 用给定变换作用于形状及其元数据。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Transform Without Rotate
components.info: Transform a shape and its meta data with a given transformation, while retaining the original orientation.
components.summary: 应用变换但保持原朝向。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Transform Without Scale
components.info: Transform a shape and its meta data with a given transformation, while retaining the original size.
components.summary: 应用变换但保持原尺寸。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Combine Transformations
components.info: Combine multiple transformations into a single one.
components.summary: 把多个变换合成一个变换。

detail.concept: 把多个变换合成一个。先转再移还是先移再转，结果完全不同。
steps: 再接 Transform Geometry 一次成型。

scenes.title: 先旋转后平移
scenes.body: 把「绕自身转 30 度」与「移到目标位置」合成，避免两次变换带来的坐标混乱。

pitfalls: 变换不满足交换律，顺序接反结果就错。
合成后难以单独调整其中一步，调试期建议先分开看。
detail.tip: 接线顺序就是执行顺序，心里默念一遍「先什么、后什么」。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Invert Transformation
components.info: Create the inverse of a transformation, when possible.

inputs.name: Transformation
inputs.info: Transformation to invert. This transformation must not involve projections onto planes, lines or points.

components.summary: 在可能的情况下求出变换的逆变换。

components.author: DavidR
components.name: Repeat Transformation
components.info: Fully repeat a transformation a given number of times.
components.summary: 把变换完整重复指定次数。
